# Filled reference constructor prefixes

Owned Java inputs create Object[] and Object[][] arguments before this/super delegation. A provider observes each array before parent construction. Frozen direct, separately compiled, reflection and MethodHandle callers check fresh allocation, component types, element identity and order, callback mutation, substitution, class initialization, partial construction, final fields and original failure identity. Source and SDK profiles compile every recovered unit and compare original definitions, method roles, Signature and Exceptions. Only this owned fixture executes.

D8 emits filled-array operations for the Object[] cases and allocation/store sequences for Object[][]. The latter exercise overwritten incoming registers at the initialized boundary. Native cases separately cover filled arrays with array-valued components and reject later reads of discarded words.
